falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match is invalidated because the August 2024 bottom saw lower highs for 3 weeks post-trough; an immediate breakout to new highs breaks the structural similarity and suggests this is not a bottom but a bear market rally or different regime entirely

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX compression to pre-correction levels would falsify the bottom thesis because August 2024's bottom featured VIX remaining elevated (15-20) for 2+ weeks post-low as de-risking continued; immediate vol collapse implies no genuine capitulation occurred

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 2+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would invalidate the pattern because the August 2024 bottom coincided with yields rising on growth scare resolution; a flight-to-quality bid driving yields sub-3.80% indicates recession panic rather than soft-landing bottom, breaking the macro analog

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
